title: Stack resources
description: CPU, memory, network and disk used by this telemetry stack's containers, and how much data ClickHouse stores.

panels.title: CPU (last 5 min)
panels.description: CPU used by the stack's containers over the 5 minutes before the end of the time range. 100% is one CPU core. Needs docker-compose.resources.yml in COMPOSE_FILE.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(rate) * 100 AS cpu FROM ( SELECT ResourceAttributes['compose.service'] AS container, sum(Value) / 1e9 / (sum(dateDiff('millisecond', StartTimeUnix, TimeUnix)) / 1e3) AS rate FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE ServiceName = 'container-stats' AND MetricName = 'container.cpu.usage.total' AND TimeUnix > $__toTime - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND TimeUnix <= $__toTime GROUP BY container)

panels.title: Memory (last 5 min)
panels.description: Memory used by the stack's containers, from the latest sample in the 5 minutes before the end of the time range. Needs docker-compose.resources.yml in COMPOSE_FILE.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(memory) AS memory FROM ( SELECT ResourceAttributes['compose.service'] AS container, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS memory FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE ServiceName = 'container-stats' AND MetricName = 'container.memory.usage.total' AND TimeUnix > $__toTime - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND TimeUnix <= $__toTime GROUP BY container)

panels.title: Peak memory
panels.description: The most memory the stack's containers used at once in the time range. Needs docker-compose.resources.yml in COMPOSE_FILE.

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(total) AS peak FROM ( SELECT minute, sum(memory) AS total FROM ( SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) AS minute, ResourceAttributes['compose.service'] AS container, max(Value) AS memory FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE ServiceName = 'container-stats' AND MetricName = 'container.memory.usage.total' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY minute, container) GROUP BY minute)

panels.title: Telemetry data
panels.description: Disk space the stored telemetry uses in ClickHouse, now. It is kept for one year.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(bytes_on_disk) AS stored FROM system.parts WHERE active AND database = 'otel'

panels.title: ClickHouse logs
panels.description: Disk space ClickHouse's own logs use (the system database), now. The stack keeps only the query, error and asynchronous insert logs, for a week or less.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(bytes_on_disk) AS stored FROM system.parts WHERE active AND database = 'system'

panels.title: Free disk
panels.description: Free space on the disk that holds ClickHouse's data, now.

targets.rawSql: SELECT free_space AS free FROM system.disks WHERE name = 'default'

panels.title: CPU by container
panels.description: CPU used by each container. 100% is one CPU core. Needs docker-compose.resources.yml in COMPOSE_FILE.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, ResourceAttributes['compose.service'] AS container, sum(Value) / 1e9 / (sum(dateDiff('millisecond', StartTimeUnix, TimeUnix)) / 1e3) * 100 AS cpu FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE ServiceName = 'container-stats' AND MetricName = 'container.cpu.usage.total' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time, container ORDER BY time

panels.title: Memory by container
panels.description: Memory used by each container. Needs docker-compose.resources.yml in COMPOSE_FILE.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, ResourceAttributes['compose.service'] AS container, avg(Value) AS memory FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE ServiceName = 'container-stats' AND MetricName = 'container.memory.usage.total' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time, container ORDER BY time

panels.title: Network traffic by container
panels.description: Bytes each container sent and received, mostly telemetry moving between the stack's own services. Needs docker-compose.resources.yml in COMPOSE_FILE.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, container, sum(rate) AS bytes FROM ( SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, ResourceAttributes['compose.service'] AS container, sum(Value) / (sum(dateDiff('millisecond', StartTimeUnix, TimeUnix)) / 1e3) AS rate FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE ServiceName = 'container-stats' AND MetricName IN ('container.network.io.usage.rx_bytes', 'container.network.io.usage.tx_bytes') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time, container, MetricName ) GROUP BY time, container ORDER BY time

panels.title: Disk I/O by container
panels.description: Bytes each container read from and wrote to disk. Reads served from the page cache don't count. Needs docker-compose.resources.yml in COMPOSE_FILE.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, container, sum(rate) AS bytes FROM ( SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, ResourceAttributes['compose.service'] AS container, sum(Value) / (sum(dateDiff('millisecond', StartTimeUnix, TimeUnix)) / 1e3) AS rate FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE ServiceName = 'container-stats' AND MetricName IN ('container.blockio.io_service_bytes_recursive') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time, container, Attributes['operation'] ) GROUP BY time, container ORDER BY time

panels.title: Storage by table
panels.description: Records and disk space per ClickHouse table, now: telemetry in otel, ClickHouse's own logs in system. Compression is the uncompressed size divided by the size on disk.

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(database, '.', table) AS table, sum(rows) AS records, sum(bytes_on_disk) AS on_disk, sum(data_uncompressed_bytes) / nullIf(sum(bytes_on_disk), 0) AS compression FROM system.parts WHERE active GROUP BY table ORDER BY on_disk DESC

panels.title: Stored records by source
panels.description: Records stored per source, by the time they describe. Antigravity history imported on first start appears on the days it happened.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, source, sum(n) AS records FROM ( SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, ServiceName AS source, count() AS n FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time, source UNION ALL SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, ServiceName AS source, count() AS n FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time, source UNION ALL SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, ServiceName AS source, count() AS n FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time, source UNION ALL SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, ServiceName AS source, count() AS n FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) GROUP BY time, source UNION ALL SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, ServiceName AS source, count() AS n FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) GROUP BY time, source ) GROUP BY time, source ORDER BY time
